# Crustdata test fixtures

- `account_company_rates.json` contains the relevant fields recorded from the
  T02 account preflight on 2026-11-22, with fields unrelated to this test omitted.
- `company_enrich_documented.json` contains a company response example
  from [Crustdata's field selection guide](https://docs.crustdata.com/company-docs/enrichment/introduction).
  The example is included to exercise the published response shape. Deck A
  fixtures will come from the separate T02 live entity probe.
